title: How LocalPlumbers Works: Free Plumber Introductions
description: How LocalPlumbers compares ways to find a plumber in the UK and USA, how introductions and partner links work, what we check and what you should check yourself.
intro: LocalPlumbers helps you compare your options and get introduced to plumbers in your area. Here's exactly what we do, what we don't, and how we make money.

image.alt: A pair of copper pipes on a wall

heroHtml: Find a plumber in your area →

items.title: Choose your area
items.text: UK or USA first, then your region, nation or state.

items.title: Describe the job
items.text: Pick the job type and how soon you need help.

items.title: Compare routes
items.text: See quote partners for your area, registers and guides.

items.title: Check and book
items.text: Check credentials, compare written quotes, then book.

sections.html:
• Organise plumbing advice by country and region so it applies where you live.
  • Compare the main ways to find a plumber: quote marketplaces, review directories, official registers and local firms.
  • Introduce you to quote partners that cover your area, when we have them.

• We don't employ, train, vet or guarantee plumbers.
  • We don't publish made-up prices, ratings or reviews.
  • We don't collect your address. The optional town or postcode in the finder stays in your browser.

Some links go to partners who may pay us a referral fee if you use their service. That never changes what you pay. Partner links are marked and use our Shmor.ai affiliate disclosure. LocalPlumbers is part of the Shmor.ai network.

faqs.a: LocalPlumbers is part of the Shmor.ai network of comparison sites. See About Shmor.ai.

faqs.q: I'm a plumber. Can I be listed?
faqs.a: We're building partnerships with quote services across the UK and USA. Get in touch through Shmor.ai contact.
